subject: Next steps: technical showcase & stakeholder intro for Acme Health
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Claire Adams <claire@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call — Redwood inference fit for Acme Health

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Key needs we heard: low-latency clinical summarization for patient notes, strict data isolation (PHI), and procurement timeline in Q4.
2) Next meeting: technical showcase + security Q&A (45–60m) where we demo a short workflow and have our security lead walk through controls.
3) Attendees we recommend: platform/infra lead (your side), security/compliance, procurement (for timeline/PO discussion), plus Redwood SE + Security.

Proposed times (PST): Thu 7/15 9:30–10:30am, Thu 7/15 1:30–2:30pm, Mon 7/19 11:00–12:00pm. If none work, share preferred windows and we’ll adapt.

I’ve attached a short showcase agenda and a security checklist we typically share ahead of Q&A. Ben (SE) will prepare a tailored demo focusing on prefix caching and privacy controls.

Quick ask: please confirm which of the attendees (platform, security, procurement) you want to include and who we should loop in on your side.

Thanks — look forward to the next step.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
